text: CI runs internal/verify's tests, the Python tests under the pinned image's minor version and the gate's own integration tests in two shards each, on runners of their own (#345). A script lists each job's top-level tests, sorted by package and name, and each shard runs every other one, so every test runs in exactly one shard and a new test lands in one with no change to the workflow. invariant/integration runs only the tests the integration build tag adds, since invariant/verify and its shards run the rest, and invariant/gate needs every shard. internal/verify's tests had taken most of each of those jobs, and invariant/integration, at about 14 minutes, was the gate's slowest check.
